items.title: Autodesk tackles AI filmmaking's biggest problem by offering 3D control
items.titleZh: Autodesk 用 3D 控制解决 AI 电影制作的关键难题
items.summary: Flow Studio's 3D Editor and Canvas let creators block scenes, direct performances, and control cameras before AI generates and refines the final visuals.
items.summaryZh: Flow Studio 的 3D Editor 与 Canvas 让创作者先在三维空间完成场面调度、表演和镜头控制，再由 AI 生成并细化最终画面。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · AIGC 制作

items.title: How animators and AI researchers made ‘Dear Upstairs Neighbors’
items.titleZh: 动画师与 AI 研究者如何制作《楼上的邻居》
items.summary: Animation veterans and Google DeepMind researchers combined handcrafted storyboards and designs with customized video-to-video workflows while preserving fine-grained artistic control.
items.summaryZh: 动画从业者与 Google DeepMind 研究者将手工分镜、角色设计和定制视频到视频流程结合，在使用生成式 AI 的同时保留细粒度艺术控制。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · 动画制作

items.title: China's AI animated micro-drama sector eyes global expansion
items.titleZh: 中国 AI 动画微短剧加速走向海外市场
items.summary: China's AI-generated animated short-drama sector is adding roughly 6,000 new titles each month and is looking toward wider global distribution.
items.summaryZh: 中国 AI 动画微短剧行业每月新增作品约 6,000 部，并开始把更广泛的海外发行作为增长方向。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · AI 漫剧

items.title: China Literature Limited 2025 Annual Results Announcement
items.titleZh: 阅文推出“漫剧助手”，贯通文字到视觉的生产流程
items.summary: China Literature says its AI-animated Drama Assistant connects multiple multimodal models to support the full workflow from text to visuals; related revenue exceeded RMB100 million after launching in the second half of 2025.
items.summaryZh: 阅文表示，“漫剧助手”接入多种多模态模型，支持从文字到视觉的完整制作流程；AI 动画短剧业务自 2025 年下半年启动以来，收入已超过 1 亿元人民币。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · AI 漫剧工具

items.title: AniMatrix: An Anime Video Generation Model that Thinks in Art, Not Physics
items.titleZh: AniMatrix：以艺术规律而非物理规律驱动的动漫视频生成模型
items.summary: AniMatrix models anime production variables such as style, motion, camera, and VFX so intentional deformation is treated as artistic direction rather than a physical error.
items.summaryZh: AniMatrix 将风格、运动、镜头和 VFX 等动漫生产变量结构化，使模型把夸张形变识别为艺术指令，而不是物理错误。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · 动漫模型

items.title: Artists, Engineers, and Generative AI in Animation Production
items.titleZh: SIGGRAPH：艺术家、工程师与生成式 AI 如何协同动画生产
items.summary: The production team behind Dear Upstairs Neighbors discusses how artists, researchers, and engineers integrated generative AI into an animation pipeline while balancing experimentation and control.
items.summaryZh: 《楼上的邻居》制作团队讨论艺术家、研究者和工程师如何把生成式 AI 接入动画管线，并在实验速度与创作控制之间取得平衡。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · 动画流程

items.title: TikTok And Cannes Push Vertical Drama Toward The Mainstream
items.titleZh: TikTok 与戛纳推动竖屏短剧走向主流
items.summary: TikTok is licensing Indian microdramas across multiple markets while AI-made vertical films are entering Cannes film-market discussions, signaling broader global distribution.
items.summaryZh: TikTok 开始在多个市场授权印度微短剧，AI 竖屏影片也进入戛纳电影市场讨论，显示这一内容形态正从应用内消费走向更广泛的全球发行。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · 短剧分发

items.title: Hollywood gets into the microdrama race as mobile-first storytelling draws stars and major studios
items.titleZh: 好莱坞明星与大型制片厂加速布局微短剧
items.summary: Studios, celebrities, and platforms are investing in one-to-three-minute mobile-first serials; Omdia estimates global microdrama revenue could reach $14 billion by the end of 2026.
items.summaryZh: 制片厂、明星与平台正在投资每集一至三分钟的移动优先连续剧；Omdia 预计全球微短剧收入到 2026 年底可能达到 140 亿美元。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · 短剧商业

items.title: Holywater Series A funding boosts My Drama apps as microdramas grow in U.S.
items.titleZh: Holywater 获 2,200 万美元融资，扩张 AI-first 微短剧业务
items.summary: Holywater raised a $22 million Series A to grow My Drama and its other products, combining AI-first content production with data-driven user acquisition and distribution.
items.summaryZh: Holywater 完成 2,200 万美元 A 轮融资，用于扩张 My Drama 等产品，其模式将 AI-first 内容生产与数据驱动的获客和分发结合。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · 短剧融资

items.title: The ‘digital revolution’ of vertical drama
items.titleZh: 竖屏短剧的数字化革命：高频钩子、付费解锁与移动消费
items.summary: Vertical dramas use short chapters, cliffhangers, mobile viewing, and gamified payments; the industry is also confronting consent and rights issues around AI-generated actors and worldscapes.
items.summaryZh: 竖屏短剧依赖短章节、强钩子、移动观看与游戏化付费，同时也开始面对 AI 生成演员、场景以及肖像授权带来的权利问题。
items.selectionReason: 业务领域预览 · 短剧制作
